# CuratedbyPriti

> CuratedbyPriti is a handmade and hand-picked gift shop in Wagle Estate, Thane West, Maharashtra, India. It makes soft pipe cleaner bouquets that do not wilt, framed florals, Lippan and mirror-work wall decor, pearl canvases, illustration portraits and custom gift hampers. Most pieces can be personalised.

## Key facts
- Address: Wagle Industrial Estate, Thane West, Thane, Maharashtra 400604, India
- Opening hours: Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 8 pm. Closed Sunday
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 90299 79652
- Email: prajapatianu1@gmail.com
- Instagram: @curatedbypriti (owner @ft._priti)
- Delivery: Thane, Bhiwandi, Airoli and many more areas around Thane
- Prices: ₹300 to ₹2,199. 11 pieces on offer, savings up to 36%
- How to order: tap choices on the order page and send the message on WhatsApp, or walk in to the shop
